Simple Process

Three Steps to a Cleaner Property.

1

Request Your Free Estimate

Submit basic information and choose a preferred appointment time. Takes less than 2 minutes.

2

Receive Your Personalized Estimate

We review your property details and send you a custom, itemized estimate — no guesswork, no hidden fees.

3

Approve & Confirm

Once you approve your estimate, your appointment becomes officially scheduled and locked in.

Please Note: Requesting an estimate does not require payment and does not automatically confirm your appointment. Your selected time slot is held as a temporary reservation while your estimate is being prepared.

Once you receive your personalized estimate, you will have 6 hours to review and approve it. If the estimate is not approved within that window, your reserved time slot will be released and made available for other clients. We appreciate your prompt response and will always do our best to accommodate your preferred schedule.

Privacy Policy

Introduction

Jetify Wash respects customer privacy and is committed to protecting information collected through estimates, scheduling, invoicing, payment processing and customer communications.

Information We Collect

We may collect names, phone numbers, email addresses, service addresses, project details, uploaded photos, communication records, invoices, estimates and payment transaction information.

How We Use Information

To provide estimates, schedule services, communicate project updates, send invoices, process payments, improve services, maintain records and comply with legal obligations.

SMS & Email Communications

Customers may receive transactional messages regarding appointments, technician arrival, estimates, invoices, project updates and review requests. These messages are service related.

Payment Information

Online payments may be processed by third-party payment providers. Jetify Wash does not intentionally store complete payment card details.

Sharing Information

Information may be shared with software providers, payment processors and service partners necessary for business operations. We do not sell customer information.

Photos & Documentation

Before-and-after photographs may be collected for documentation, quality control and marketing unless otherwise requested.

Data Security

Reasonable administrative and technical safeguards are used; however, no transmission or storage method is completely secure.

Retention

Information may be retained as reasonably necessary for business, accounting, legal and operational purposes.

Customer Rights

Customers may request corrections to inaccurate information and may contact Jetify Wash regarding privacy questions.

Policy Changes

This policy may be updated periodically. Continued use of our services constitutes acceptance of revisions.

Contact: JetifyWash@gmail.com

Terms & Conditions

Scope

These terms apply to residential and commercial pressure washing and exterior cleaning services provided by Jetify Wash.

Estimates

Estimates are based on visible conditions and information available at the time of inspection. Additional work may require revised pricing.

Scheduling & Weather

Appointments may be rescheduled due to weather, safety concerns, equipment issues or circumstances outside our control.

Cancellation

Appointments cancelled with less than 24 hours notice may be subject to a cancellation or trip fee.

Property Access

Customers must provide safe access to service areas and secure pets. Vehicles and personal property should be moved from work areas.

Water & Utilities

Customer authorizes reasonable use of on-site water and utilities required to perform services.

Service Results

Complete removal of stains, rust, oxidation, oil spots, paint discoloration and deeply embedded contaminants cannot be guaranteed.

Pre-Existing Conditions

Jetify Wash is not responsible for damage related to pre-existing defects including loose siding, cracked surfaces, deteriorated wood, failing paint, damaged seals, loose mortar, faulty windows or weakened materials.

Surface Disclosure

Cleaning may reveal pre-existing damage, discoloration, oxidation or defects previously hidden by dirt, algae, mildew or debris.

Payment Terms

Payment is due upon completion unless otherwise agreed. Electronic invoices and online payment requests may be issued through business software providers.

Chargebacks

Customers agree to provide Jetify Wash an opportunity to inspect and address concerns before initiating disputes or chargebacks.

Claims

Service concerns must be reported within 48 hours of completion.

Photography Release

Before-and-after photographs may be used for documentation and marketing unless declined in writing.

Limitation of Liability

To the maximum extent permitted by law, liability shall not exceed the amount paid for the specific service giving rise to the claim.

Governing Law

These terms shall be governed by applicable laws of Kansas.

Contact: JetifyWash@gmail.com
